chunks.text: [Lineage] {instrumental}{solo felt piano plays the three-note motif from the very first beat}
positive_styles: cinematic hybrid orchestral score for a premium tech launch film
one simple memorable three-note motif (B-flat, C, F) that every section is built on
industrial percussion: anvil strikes, metallic impacts, typewriter rhythm
great production quality, wide stereo, clean mix
the motif on a single felt piano, one note on each beat

chunks.text: [Weight] {instrumental}{tension rises relentlessly to the last beat}
positive_styles: the same motif repeated faster and higher, tightening

chunks.text: [Drop] {instrumental}{enormous orchestral impact on the very first beat, no ramp, no build-up}
positive_styles: massive drop exactly on the first beat
huge low brass and distorted sub impact
full orchestra with taiko and anvil hits
the motif in full power on brass
after three seconds it settles into one long sustained low note with shimmering high strings

chunks.text: [Build] {instrumental}{full driving rhythm from the very first beat}
positive_styles: the motif on strings, confident and joyful

chunks.text: [Leap] {instrumental}{near silence for four seconds}{then a slow swell}{the final chord rings out to the very end, no fade-out}
positive_styles: a single sustained high string note and the soft piano motif
slow swell in the final four seconds
resolves on a warm B-flat major chord
